verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh is API-first, so it can run without the UI. It issues API credentials with configurable permissions and expiry, and it supports synchronous, asynchronous and batch screening plus webhooks for event-driven results. Cases and alerts can be remediated fully through the API, and a Postman collection and OpenAPI schema support integration. Missing for 10: no CLI or CI-specific tooling (e.g., pipeline integrations or a documented sandbox/test environment), and no hands-on or independent corroboration of headless automated runs.
